IMPORTANT clean architectural plate ONLY: remove ALL freestanding counters, tables, chairs, benches, shelves, gifts, plants in pots and foreground furniture; leave beautiful empty floor in lower 48% and open wall space left and right for composited furniture. No menu text/prices, no characters, no purple gold excess or bloom. Pixel-perfect richly shaded retro game art, not simplified vectors, not photograph.
